name: code-stats
description: Count the lines of code in a project: code, comment and blank lines for 40+ languages, totals per folder, and the largest files. It respects the project's .gitignore, skips node_modules, .git and build folders, and flags minified or generated files so they don't inflate the numbers. Exclude folders or patterns, untick single files, then export an HTML report with a bar chart, an Excel workbook and a CSV summary. Runs locally; no upload or API keys.
